upstream.description: Desktop app to multi-prompt ChatGPT, Gemini and more at the same time!

classification.analysis: LLM-God is a Windows-first Electron desktop app that embeds multiple LLM chat web interfaces (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, Copilot) as browser views side by side, letting a user broadcast one prompt to all of them at once via Ctrl+Enter and paste text or screenshots into a shared input. It works by JavaScript-injecting into each provider's web UI (login required per service) rather than calling any API, so it's a productivity wrapper, not an LLM client library. Aimed at individuals who want to quickly compare answers across multiple chat providers without copy-pasting between browser tabs.

use_cases.title: Compare answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude side by side
Broadcast one prompt to several AI chat web UIs at once
Paste a screenshot into multiple LLM chats simultaneously
